title.classFeaturesSpellsAndRules: Class features, spells and rules are paraphrased and adapted to a rank-based, dice-tray game. Each feature on a hero sheet is tagged exact, adapted or narrative. Monsters, biomes, charms, curses, the Fortune Tray and all art are original to Treasure Dice.

town.theLanternKeepUnderThe: The Lantern Keep — Under the Dragon
town.aDrinkIsWaitingFor: A drink is waiting for your next run
town.clickAHeroToSee: Click a hero to see their sheet, gear and spells.
town.aShortGentlePracticeDungeon: A short, gentle practice dungeon under the Keep: one fight, a treasure room, the Boss Sigil and a sparring boss. Nobody can die there, and your heroes come back one level stronger.
town.levelSpreadOfTheDungeon: Level spread of {spread}: the dungeon is tuned to the party as a whole, so your weakest hero will struggle. Consider the Training Grounds.
town.finishTheirLevelUpIn: Finish their level-up in the Guild Hall first.
town.finalStageALongStarfall: Final stage: a long Starfall dungeon, and Tiamat on her throne in place of its boss. Her Chromatic Dominion curse debuffs Ember, Verdant, Shadow, Frost and Storm dice and cuts Mult to ×0.75.
town.consumablesInTheVaultUp: Consumables in the Vault (up to six stacks) are packed automatically. Your Fortune — dice bag, charms, omens, doubloons — starts fresh in every echo.
town.aDissentEnteredBeforeThe: A Dissent, entered before the Fifth Door
town.aKeeperOfThisHouse: A Keeper of this house warned that the Doors were never meant to be broken. The Guild read the warning and pressed on.
town.copiedFromTheInsideOf: Copied from the inside of the Sixth Door
town.allFiveEchoesAreBroken: All five echoes are broken and you have a champion at the height of their power. Choose the Dragon Throne in the Cartographer.
town.requiresAllFiveEchoesCleared: Requires all five echoes cleared ({v}/5) and a level {FINALE_LEVEL} hero in the party. Your strongest living hero is level {v2}.
town.aCardWithYourThree: A card with your three best heroes, the echoes you have broken, and your record. Save it as an image or share it.
town.equipGearFromAHero: Equip gear from a hero's sheet in the Guild Hall. Selling returns 40% of value.
town.emptyTreasureCarriedHomeFrom: Empty. Treasure carried home from a dungeon lands here.
town.browserStorageCanBeCleared: Browser storage can be cleared. Export a backup file now and then.
town.theTrainingGroundsAreClosed: The Training Grounds are closed while Drillmaster Kost leads the evacuation. They reopen when Tiamat falls.
town.payToRaiseABenched: Pay to raise a benched hero by one level, up to level {cap} (two below your strongest trio). Clearing dungeons is the only other way to level.

modals.conHitPointsVitalityResources: +{hpGain} + CON hit points (× vitality). Resources and spell slots refreshed.
modals.moreHitPointsAndA: More hit points and a stronger foundation.
modals.permanentChangesToThisHero: Permanent changes to this hero's signature dice, which join the bag on every expedition.
modals.aMilestoneRankChooseA: A milestone rank: choose a permanent upgrade for this run.
modals.chooseABoonForThis: Choose a boon for this run.
modals.chooseACharmOrOmen: Choose a charm or omen to give up for the new one.
modals.offerADieToThe: Offer a die to the altar
modals.clickAFaceOnAny: Click a face on any die.
modals.charmsDiceOmensAllOf: "Charms, dice, omens — all of it lucky, most of it legal."
modals.charmsOrderMattersTheyScore: Charms {charmsLength}/{charmSlots} — order matters: they score left to right
modals.practiceMakesPerfectNobodyDied: Practice makes perfect. Nobody died, and the Training Cellar is still open in the Cartographer.
modals.thisRunSCharmsNow: This run's charms, now gone with the echo:
modals.keys19SelectDice: Keys: 1–9 select dice · R reroll · A/B/C/D/G menus · E end turn · Esc back · arrows to explore.
modals.pickThreeHeroesAndAn: Pick three heroes and an echo in the Cartographer and open its door. Explore with Forward, Left, Right and Back. Find the Boss Sigil, kill the boss, and walk out alive. Every survivor gains a level. Dead heroes stay dead in Legacy mode.
modals.eachFightDealsDiceFrom: Each fight deals dice from your bag onto a shared felt tray. On a hero's turn, select dice and reroll them (1 reroll a turn, more from skills, items and charms), then choose an action. Up to five selected dice ride along as a poker-dice hand: Pair, Straight, Set (five dice of one colour), Full House, Five of a Kind…
modals.damageYourActionSReal: Damage = (your action's real dice + the hand's chips + the pips) × mult. Dice matching the acting hero's colour add +1 mult. Dice you don't play stay on the tray for the next hero. If you miss, your dice come back.
modals.afterEveryFightYourFortune: After every fight your Fortune Rank rises: choose a charm, an omen (levels up a hand while it holds a charm slot), a new die, a face enchantment, or a token. Charms score left to right, so order matters (rearrange them in the Dice bag). Doubloons earn interest; spend them at the Peddler. It all vanishes when the dungeon ends, so go big.
modals.enemiesHexYourTrayThey: Enemies hex your tray: they steal dice, jinx your best face, or flip everything. Bosses bring a curse that changes the rules for the fight. Each echo has its own meter, like Heat or Gravity, that bends both the map and the dice.
modals.tiamatTheFiveHeadedDragon: Tiamat, the five-headed Dragon Queen, stirs behind the Sixth Door. Each of her five heads feeds an echo behind a door of its own. Each echo you break tells the next chapter (see the Chronicle). Once all five echoes are broken and a hero reaches level 20, take them to the Dragon Throne in the Cartographer and end her reign.
modals.theLowLanternIsThe: The Low Lantern is the Keep's tavern. Talk to the regulars, order a drink for your next run, and follow their leads: a lead puts a quest room in its echo about one run in three, and always by the third. In a conversation, Space advances, the arrow keys choose, L shows the log and Esc skips ahead.

tutorial.tapDirectionsAreRelativeTo: **Tap {REL_LABEL}.** Directions are relative to the way you face, so the same door can be Forward one moment and Left the next.
tutorial.thisShortTourShowsYou: This short tour shows you around the Keep, then takes your three heroes through a practice dungeon: moving, one fight, treasure and a boss. They come back at level 2. You can skip it at any time.
tutorial.bankedGoldIsSafeIn: **Banked gold** is safe in the Keep. You start with 50, enough for a potion or two. Gold you find in a dungeon is only banked if you walk out alive.
tutorial.sigilsComeFromBeatingEcho: **Sigils** come from beating echo bosses. They pay for Keep upgrades, together with gold.
tutorial.theKeepIsABig: The Keep is a big menu
tutorial.guildHallYourRosterLevel: **Guild Hall**: your roster, level-ups and recruits.
tutorial.chronicleTheStorySoFar: **Chronicle**: the story so far, and your share card.
tutorial.cartographerPickThreeHeroesAnd: **Cartographer**: pick three heroes and a dungeon.
tutorial.enchanterTrainingUpgradeGearTrain: **Enchanter / Training**: upgrade gear, train benched heroes, upgrade the Keep.
tutorial.vaultCodexYourLootAnd: **Vault / Codex**: your loot, and everything you have discovered.
tutorial.clickAnyTabToSwitch: Click any tab to switch. The tour will take you to the ones that matter now.
tutorial.theseAreYourFirstThree: These are your first three heroes: {map}. A fighter up front, a cleric to heal, and a rogue for big hits.
tutorial.clickAHeroToOpen: **Click a hero** to open their sheet.
tutorial.everythingAboutAHeroHp: Everything about a hero: HP, AC, ability scores, gear slots, class features and spells. In the Keep you equip gear from the Vault here and choose prepared spells.
tutorial.closeAnyWindowWithEsc: Close any window with **Esc** or by clicking outside it. (Next closes it for you.)
tutorial.moreHeroesAreForHire: More heroes are for hire here, from all twelve classes. Each has their own colour of dice. Hiring costs gold, but volunteers sign on free whenever you have fewer than three living heroes.
tutorial.everyRecruitHasAUnique: Every recruit has a unique name, so nobody gets mixed up on the Wall of the Fallen.
tutorial.yourStoryTiamatTheDragon: Your story. Tiamat the Dragon Queen is stirring behind the Sixth Door, and each of her heads feeds an echo behind a door of its own. Each echo you break tells the next chapter.
tutorial.toFaceHerYouNeed: To face her you need at least one hero at **level {FINALE_LEVEL}**. Heroes gain one level for every dungeon they clear and survive.
tutorial.pickYourThreeHeroesHere: Pick your three heroes here. Click a card to add or remove it. A good party has a front-liner, a healer and someone who hits hard.
tutorial.belowThatYouPickAn: Below that you pick an echo (a dungeon), the difficulty and the length.
tutorial.aSmallPracticeDungeonWaits: A small practice dungeon waits under the Keep. It is gentle, and nobody can die there, even in Legacy mode.
tutorial.thisIsTheRoomYou: This is the room you are standing in: its name, what you see, and the echo's meter (Heat, here) at the top left.
tutorial.theCompassAtTheTop: The compass at the top right shows which way you are **facing**.
tutorial.moveForwardLeftRightOr: Move **Forward, Left, Right or Back** relative to the way you face, with these buttons or the arrow keys / WASD. Each button shows what lies that way; a dash means a wall.
tutorial.turningDownASidePassage: Turning down a side passage changes your facing, so keep an eye on the compass.
tutorial.theMapFillsInAs: The map fills in as you explore. The arrow is you. ☠ is the boss, ⚿ the Boss Sigil, $ treasure, ? an event, ⌂ a camp.
tutorial.inEveryDungeonYouNeed: In every dungeon you need the Boss Sigil to open the boss's door.
tutorial.theJournalRecordsEverythingThat: The journal records everything that happens. Below it is your party: click a portrait for their sheet. Potions and healing spells are under **Supplies** on the right.
tutorial.goblinsAreJustAheadWalking: Goblins are just ahead. Walking into an occupied room starts a fight.
tutorial.foesStandInAFront: Foes stand in a **front** and a **back** rank. Melee attacks can only reach the front rank while it stands. Hover a foe to see its AC and weaknesses.
tutorial.yourHeroesAreAlongThe: Your heroes are along the bottom. The glowing one is acting now.
tutorial.everyoneActsInInitiativeOrder: Everyone acts in initiative order, shown here. Enemy turns play out on their own.
tutorial.thisIsTheHeartOf: This is the heart of the game. Every fight deals dice from your bag onto this tray, and the **whole party shares it**.
tutorial.eachDieHasAMaterial: Each die has a material (colour). Dice that match the acting hero's colour score extra Mult.
tutorial.onSTurnChooseUp: On {actorName}'s turn, choose up to five dice to play with an action. They score like poker dice: Pair, Two Pair, Three of a Kind, Straight…
tutorial.orPressTheirNumberKeys: (or press their number keys). They make {v}
tutorial.thePreviewShowsYourHand: The preview shows your hand and its
tutorial.whenYouActTheAction: . When you act, the action's real damage dice are added to the Chips, then everything is multiplied.
tutorial.onlyTheDiceThatMake: Only the dice that make the pattern score. The rest stay on the tray for the next hero.
tutorial.notHappyWithADie: Not happy with a die? Select it and **Reroll** (R). You get 1 reroll per turn; skills, items and charms can give more.
tutorial.theButtonsBesideItAre: The buttons beside it are class talents. A fighter can nudge a die ±1, a cleric can turn one into a Sun 6, and so on. Tokens (coins) are one-shot tricks.
tutorial.pickTheWeaponAttackMeans: Pick the weapon attack. 🎲 means it carries your selected dice.
tutorial.ifYouMissYourDice: If you miss, your dice come back to the tray.
tutorial.everyRollHitAndMiss: Every roll, hit and miss is written here. A big hand plays a scoring animation first, so you can watch the Chips and Mult add up.
tutorial.skillsAreClassFeaturesSecond: **Skills** are class features (Second Wind, Sneak Attack…), **Magic** holds spells, **Items** your potions, and **Guard / Move** raises a ward or switches rank.
tutorial.endTurnEPassesTo: **End turn** (E) passes to the next hero. Unplayed dice stay on the tray, so you can save a good pair for a teammate.
tutorial.eachTurnHasAnAction: Each turn has an action and a **bonus action**. Use both and the turn passes on its own.
tutorial.stillHasABonusAction: {actorName} still has a bonus action, but many heroes have nothing worth spending it on yet. That's fine: you end the turn yourself.
tutorial.selectDicePickAnAction: Select dice, pick an action, click a target. Keep going until the goblins drop.
tutorial.victoryTheMapShowsA: Victory! The map shows a room off to the side. Treasure rooms are worth the detour.
tutorial.roomActionsAppearUnderThe: Room actions appear under the room: treasure, events, the Peddler, camps and **Search**, which finds hidden doors. **Click Open the treasure.**
tutorial.theSigilKilnIsPast: The Sigil Kiln (⚿) is past the fight room.
tutorial.roomsWithOrHoldEvents: Rooms with ? or ⚿ hold events: choices, often with a skill check. Your best hero rolls, and the odds are shown before you choose.
tutorial.pickAChoiceToTake: **Pick a choice** to take the sigil.
tutorial.charmsOmensDoubloonsTokensAnd: Charms, omens, doubloons (¤), tokens and your dice bag only last for this dungeon. They build into a scoring engine as you go deeper, then vanish when the dungeon ends. So go big.
tutorial.theSlotsBelowAreYour: The slots below are your **relic tray**. Every **charm** and every **omen** (✶, +1 level to one hand) takes a slot. When it's full, a new one must replace an old one, and a sold or replaced omen takes its level with it.
tutorial.openTheDiceBagTo: Open the **Dice bag** to see every die, reorder charms (they score left to right) and check your hand levels.
tutorial.theSigilOpensTheSealed: The sigil opens the sealed door. Your heroes healed up a little after the fight; in real dungeons, camps (⌂) let you rest.
tutorial.everyBossBringsACurse: Every boss brings a **curse** that changes the dice rules for the fight. This one weakens Steel and Ember dice, so lean on the others.
tutorial.bossesAlsoHavePhasesAnd: Bosses also have phases, and they warn you (⚠) before a big attack.
tutorial.everythingYouLearnedTogetherBig: Everything you learned, together. Big hands, rerolls, talents. You've got this.
tutorial.withTheBossDownYou: With the boss down you can leave from anywhere. **Return to the Keep** to bank your gold and treasure.
tutorial.everyHeroWhoSurvivesA: Every hero who survives a cleared dungeon **gains a level**. Gold and items go to the Keep.
tutorial.inLegacyModeHeroesWho: In Legacy mode, heroes who fall in a real dungeon stay dead. In Story mode a wipe just sends you home empty-handed.
tutorial.theLevelUpWizardLists: The level-up wizard lists the new features. When a level offers a choice (a fighting style, a feat…), pick it here. Then confirm.
tutorial.heroesWithALevelWaiting: Heroes with a level waiting have a red badge. Click Level up on each of them.
tutorial.yourShareCardShowsYour: Your share card shows your three best heroes, the echoes you have broken, and whether you have beaten Tiamat. Save it as an image or share it.
tutorial.thatSTheTourNow: That's the tour. Now pick an echo and open its door for real. Each echo you break unlocks the next and tells the next chapter of the story.
tutorial.reachLevelAndTheDragon: Reach level {FINALE_LEVEL} and the Dragon Throne opens. **How to play** in the top bar has the rules whenever you need them.
tutorial.goldYouFindIsCarried: Gold you find is **carried** until you get home alive. **Doubloons** are this dungeon's currency, and you earn +1 interest for every 5 you hold.
tutorial.eachFightRaisesYourFortune: Each fight raises your **Fortune Rank**: a boon now, and every third rank a bigger upgrade.
tutorial.charmsAreLastingScoringEffects: **Charms** are lasting scoring effects for this run (5 slots). **Omens** level up a hand type and share those slots. **Dice** and **face enchants** reshape your bag. **Tokens** are one-shot tricks.
tutorial.hoverACardForDetails: Hover a card for details, then pick one. When in doubt, take a charm.
tutorial.eachOptionShowsWhichHero: Each option shows which hero rolls, their bonus and their chance. Some spells (and thieves' tools) succeed automatically.
tutorial.bossesGuardAHoardTake: Bosses guard a hoard: take one item. It goes to the Vault when you get home, and you equip it from a hero's sheet.
tutorial.tutorialSkippedHowToPlay: Tutorial skipped. "How to play" in the top bar has the rules, and can restart the tour.
tutorial.tutorialCompleteGoodLuckBeyond: Tutorial complete. Good luck beyond the doors!
tutorial.skipTheRestOfThe: Skip the rest of the tutorial?

tavern.oneDrinkPerRunIt: One drink per run. It takes effect on your next expedition.
tavern.serethHasDressedYourHeroes: Sereth has dressed your heroes' wounds. A Tonic waits for your next run.
tavern.serethTendsWoundedHeroesAt: Sereth tends wounded heroes at the foot of the Stair: a free Tonic for your next run, once a day.
tavern.takeAnEchoWithA: Take an echo with a lead in the Cartographer. The Doors shift: a lead's room turns up in about one run in three, and always by the {v}rd try.
tavern.oneCandleForEveryParty: One candle for every party that goes down the Stair. Bet lights it when you leave and pinches it out when you come home.
tavern.tiamatIsAwakeUntilA: Tiamat is awake. Until a champion can face her, the Keep prepares. The three tracks overlap: do as much as you can. Each finished track adds a boon to the Dragon Throne run.
tavern.theOnlyLightInThe: The only light in the Keep
